vars.label: Primary care physicians
vars.ref: CMS NPPES monthly full file (NPPES_November_2026_V2.zip): individual providers with an active NPI and a Puerto Rico practice location, by primary taxonomy, counted by municipio
vars.definition: Primary care physicians registered in NPPES with a practice location in the municipio (taxonomy codes 207Q, 208D, 207R00000X, 208000000X, 207V00000X). Counted at the primary practice location in the NPPES registry, by the provider's primary taxonomy code. A registry, not a head count: a provider who left, retired or works part-time may still be listed. To protect individuals, a municipio with 1 to 9 is shown empty; the island total is exact.
